source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Absence of relationality with possessive predicates
notes: However, this account immediately predicts that the oddness of (86) should disappear if inalienability is licensed by another means, namely, substituting N for an empty D node. The prediction is confirmed by (87a) which is perfectly felicitous e.g. in a situation where several grandchildren of one and the same grandmother are having an argument about exactly to which one of her grandchildren their grandmother belongs. (87b) is also a typical possession context presupposing a custody fight.
